historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly centers on lspci presence/detail, but its label-based first match is not a stable identity oracle for a multifunction DPU and the update step mutates host reference data.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly preserves numeric IDs independent of labels and excludes unapproved pciids/network changes, resets, rescans and driver mutations.

historical_reviews.v3_1: A BlueField connection is a function topology, not a single grep line. Acceptance must enumerate every expected physical and virtual function with numeric vendor/device/subsystem IDs, map them to the approved slot/root port, and verify downstream LnkSta plus AER/error context. Human-readable pciids names are convenience labels, not evidence of identity.

original_test_intent: Verify that the expected BlueField DPU and all required PCIe functions are connected at the correct topology and negotiated link state according to the platform SPEC.
original_method: Use an approved local pciids snapshot without changing it, collect complete numeric PCI topology, select candidates by expected IDs and slot/root-port path rather than text/first match, capture untruncated verbose configuration for every approved BDF, and compare subsystem/function inventory, LnkCap/LnkSta and errors with the versioned BlueField recipe.
manual_activity: The platform/DPU owner approves expected model, PCI functions, numeric IDs, slot/root-port/BDF topology, local pciids policy and mismatch disposition.
required_inputs: Expected physical/virtual function count and roles
Expected PCIe generation/width and error policy
Validated local pciids snapshot or numeric-only rule
safety_requirements: Do not run online `update-pciids` without a separate approved change
Do not select the first label match
Never expose credentials or disable host verification
Do not rescan, reset, bind/unbind or write PCIe/DPU state
Retain numeric IDs even if labels are stale
agent_execution_scope: Resolve all expected candidates from owner-approved IDs and paths
Parse function identity, subsystem, link and error state
Compare with the SPEC and report without mutation or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact BlueField function topology and IDs
Approve pciids update versus pinned local database policy
Resolve unexpected/missing functions and alternate IDs
Disposition link downtraining or PCIe errors

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command changes pciids, relies on an unsafe label grep, picks only the first candidate and cuts verbose output to 30 lines. It cannot prove all expected functions, subsystem IDs, full link context or absence of errors.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Over verified SSH or locally, use complete `lspci -Dnn`/topology output and untruncated `lspci -s <approved-BDF> -nn -vvv` for every expected BlueField function, comparing numeric identity and link/error fields to the SPEC without updating pciids.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The BlueField connection check, complete per-BDF verbose detail and 5-minute source estimate remain; `update-pciids` is treated as an optional separately governed prerequisite.

modernized_recommendation.status: NUMERIC MULTI-FUNCTION BLUEFIELD PCIe TOPOLOGY RECONCILIATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a function-level table keyed by domain:BDF and root-port path with numeric IDs, role, driver, LnkCap/LnkSta and error status for every expected BlueField endpoint.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes mutable labels and first-match/truncation shortcuts, adds multi-function topology and complete negotiated-link/error comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One BlueField-labeled function can appear while management, network or auxiliary functions are missing; a truncated block can also omit LnkSta or AER evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Collection is read-only, but stale routing/ID assumptions can validate the wrong adapter; this check does not prove DPU firmware or workload functionality.

project_override_considerations: Approve numeric IDs and function roles for the installed BlueField SKU/firmware mode, expected domain/BDF topology after BIOS changes, pciids version policy and allowed link state or recoverable error counters.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS/BlueField model identity, SPEC revision and approved slot/root-port/BDF/function map
pciutils and local pciids provenance, verified access and timestamps
Complete numeric PCI topology and untruncated per-function verbose output with exit status
Function-by-function device/subsystem, driver, LnkCap/LnkSta and error comparison
Preserved dmesg/syslog/SEL, no-update/no-rescan/no-reset audit, mismatch disposition and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define BlueField PCIe presence/detail comparison to a SPEC. The mutable `update-pciids` step is unnecessary/risky but does not contradict the test target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The connection check is clear; exact IDs/topology, tools and pciids policy are identifiable prerequisites, so classification is REQUIRES.

review_improvement: Replaces label-based first-match evidence with complete numeric, multi-function, topology-bound PCIe identity and link verification without changing host or DPU state.
independent_technical_reasoning: The pciids database only translates numeric IDs into names, so updating it cannot change hardware and cannot be required to prove connection. Conversely, a multifunction BlueField can expose several BDFs with distinct roles; selecting one named line establishes neither completeness nor correct slot routing. Numeric function inventory plus root-port and negotiated-link data is the durable connection oracle.
